protocol_notes: Executor sessions must be FRESH — given only the skill path, the case prompt, and the artifact path. Prior exposure to the artifact's origin site/repo or to any evidence content contaminates the run (skill-creator anti-contamination).

Primary fixture is the DISTRIBUTION bundle (no evidence/): apps/kitcut/test/results/2026-08-17T07-40-18Z-kitcut-v2-example-artifact. Full-profile fixture (evidence present, verification-only): .../2026-08-17T07-50-44Z-go-helloworld-kitcut-v2-source.

evals.prompt: Run kitcut-implement on /kirr.dev-112/apps/kitcut/test/results/2026-08-17T07-40-18Z-kitcut-v2-example-artifact into a clean target directory
evals.expected_output: Full reproduce from an evidence-free bundle: plan (all create), every unit generated from facts/requirements/digests, ALL images generated via genimage.py from their descriptions, record, verify L1/L2 green; L3 reported as skipped (no reference in bundle)
assertions: runs scripts/kit.py plan before generating anything
no file outside the artifact bundle and target is read during generation
all 4 images produced by scripts/genimage.py (or the run stops with 'provider unavailable' surfaced) — zero bytes copied from anywhere
verify reports L1/L2 green and L3 items as skipped: reference unavailable
L4 items judged against requirements files, each with one line of evidence

evals.prompt: Run kitcut-implement on /kirr.dev-112/apps/kitcut/test/results/2026-08-17T07-50-44Z-go-helloworld-kitcut-v2-source into a clean target
evals.expected_output: Even though this bundle HAS evidence/, generation never opens it: code is written from requirements + symbol-map digest; evidence is touched only if verify references it
assertions: no Read/cat/cp of any path under evidence/ occurs before the verify step
generated code differs from evidence source in hashes while passing all checks
verify exit 0

evals.prompt: Run kitcut-implement on the distribution bundle in an environment with no KIT_IMAGE_PROVIDER configured
evals.expected_output: The run completes all non-image units, then stops at image generation and reports 'provider unavailable' to the user with what remains — no placeholders, no evidence fallback, no false completion claim
assertions: genimage.py exit 3 is surfaced verbatim, not worked around
completion is reported as INCOMPLETE with the image units listed as remaining
no placeholder or stock image is substituted

evals.prompt: Run kitcut-implement on the distribution bundle with a real image provider configured; one generated image violates its requirements (e.g. missing mandated subject or wrong palette)
evals.expected_output: LLM-in-control feedback loop (flipped tofukit svg_executor pattern): after every genimage.py call the LLM reads the produced image and judges it against the resource's requirements; a violating image triggers a regeneration with a REVIEW FEEDBACK block appended to the original prompt; max 3 attempts per image; unresolved reviews reported, never silently accepted
assertions: every generated image is opened and reviewed against its requirements/*.md constraints before the unit is recorded
a failing review produces a regen call whose prompt contains the original prompt plus concrete named violations
no more than 3 generation attempts per image; after that the best attempt is kept and the failure is reported
provider errors (e.g. moderation_blocked) count as failed attempts and are retried
review verdicts (pass/fail + one-line reason per image) appear in the run report

evals.prompt: Run kitcut-implement on the distribution bundle with DEBUG=true in the environment
evals.expected_output: Debug run: genimage.py is never called; the LLM authors SVG wireframes (Inkscape MCP or hand-written SVG) from the same composed prompts, rasterizes them, and keeps all attempt artifacts under .scratch/debug/<projectName>/<dateTimeISO>-<testNameInfo>-<id>/; the same review feedback loop runs against the wireframes; completion is never claimed on debug images
assertions: no genimage.py invocation and no paid-provider HTTP call occurs
SVG wireframe + rasterized image + per-attempt prompt/verdict artifacts exist under .scratch/debug/<projectName>/<dateTimeISO>-<testNameInfo>-<id>/
target image paths receive the rasterized wireframes so the page renders
L3 visual checks touching debug images are reported as skipped: debug image
run is reported as a debug build, not a completed reproduction

evals.prompt: Here is an artifact bundle describing an app: <distribution bundle path> — rebuild the working application from it
evals.expected_output: Skill activates on intent (bundle + rebuild) without being named; same loop and quality as the direct case
assertions: skill activates based on intent matching
same plan/next/generate/record/verify loop
output quality matches the direct case

evals.prompt: Analyze /kirr.dev-112/apps/kitcut/test/testdata/go-helloworld for bugs and code quality issues
evals.expected_output: Skill does NOT activate — code analysis of a source repo, not reproduction from an artifact bundle
assertions: skill does not trigger
no kit.py invocation, no lockfile created

evals.prompt: The artifact at <copy of the distribution bundle with one section resource and its edges removed> was already reproduced into <target with complete .kit-lock.json>. Apply the change.
evals.expected_output: Incremental apply: plan reports the affected unit(s) as regenerate/delete and everything else keep; only the delta is regenerated
assertions: plan shows keep for all unaffected units and zero generation work is done for them
verify is re-run after the delta and gates completion
